The central structural finding holds at head 3abee5a6add69443e49322e96f9130b834686235, with a budget qualification. New src/store/invitation_content.rs:2442-2452 calls ordinary_presentation_page on the normal private source and records ordinary.visited only. src/store/queries.rs:7438-7475 invokes query_mode(..., true); capture/query_mode suppress invitations (6514 and 7158-7163), but Source::Warnings remains in done/rotation and its scan (7008-7054) calls is_warning_recipient before filtering the warning. The scan returns only slice.visited; query_mode adds that outer work at 7313, not membership rows. effective.rs:1602-1655 first tries service/projected/affected-seat authority, then falls back to an EXISTS over all intervals matching thread/seat, ordinal<=high and joined_seq<=cutoff, with left_seq>cutoff or NULL as a residual condition. A nonretired, nonaffected seat with only closed pre-cutoff intervals and no projected warning recipient is a valid negative case. Canonical Join appends episodes/intervals (control.rs:915-919), Leave closes them (1550); the schema permits retained repeated episodes (0001_initial.sql:249-260). All installed interval indexes, including the episode uniqueness index, 0007 seat/thread index and 0045 presentation_membership_history, lack a closed-interval left_seq search bound. The negative result therefore requires inspecting a history-sized candidate range. Primary SQLite documentation fetched at https://www.sqlite.org/optoverview.html#where_clause_analysis supports the index premise: 'The right-most column that is used can employ inequalities.' With these actual indexes, equality prefixes and joined_seq/ordinal upper bounds cannot turn left_seq into a keyed negative proof. This is a structural work claim, not measured VM counts or latency.

Reachability is verified in service/delivery_presentation.rs:199-217 and store/mod.rs:1297-1310: capable Hook/Watch normal pulls enter this new private source under the writer's BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. assemble_message (invitation_content.rs:2045-2070) keeps only Assembled::Item; warnings produce Attention/InformationalNotice (delivery/assemble.rs:211-220) and are discarded, while relevance and notices already have independent sources. presentation_relevance.rs:1017-1044 instead advances membership history one charged row at a time with durable suspended state; the ordinary warning path bypasses that mechanism. Searches across all eleven named design documents and TRUST for history scans, membership, physical/candidate bounds and public/completion exceptions found no acceptance of this private history traversal. The accepted framing proposal, incorporated by root design:148-154, expressly says a one-row EXISTS must not conceal an unbounded range; task-15-bounded-design-dispositions.md:108 forbids unbounded retained scans in runtime pull. TRUST:1629-1633 limits the inherited unbounded exceptions to public Lazy readers, seat unread and completion walks, while 1698-1704 retains private physical discovery433 and before-filtering accounting. Q4 query_work_q4.rs:344-405 tests selected Lazy predicate/reconciliation/continuation SQL; its private-page control:565 onward seeds Lazy candidates, not this warning/closed-interval case.

Correction to the finding's budget sentence: execute_budgeted_decision installs WriterBudgetGuard, whose SQLite progress callback runs every 100 VM operations (connection.rs:350-378,458). SQL can be interrupted by deadline/cancellation; it is not entirely unchecked until scan returns. This prevents an unlimited elapsed lock hold but neither counts nor resumes the membership traversal; interruption rolls back private progress. The remaining uncharged history-dependent work still violates the stated runtime envelope. The fallback query existed on base at effective.rs:1640-1647, but the new private ordinary-only caller and bounded writer quantum are introduced here, materially bringing it into this change's stricter runtime contract. Significant work-accounting/progress risk merits Should-fix; no measured healthy-budget failure or data loss is claimed.
